description:
Validate, normalise and mechanically repair a payload against a declared JSON-Schema subset. Repair never fabricates data: a required property with no default is reported missing, not inserted. Keywords outside the supported subset are reported in schema_keys_unsupported rather than silently ignored.

VALUE: Coercion and repair of a payload against a schema, with the repairs itemised — malformed input becomes clean input, and every change is on the record.

PRICE: $0.02 USDC per call.

HOW TO PAY: USDC on eip155:8453, exact scheme, to 0xc8fF67FAE72596478599EAAcfad8656fAe1113c8. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the exact amount and put it in the `X-PAYMENT` header, then retry the same call. An unpaid call returns a `payment_required` payload with the amount, asset, network and payTo already filled in. The `synthex-x402` SDK (PyPI and npm) does the 402 -> sign -> retry loop in one call.
name: data_validate
title: Data Validate
